info.name: Talk recording auto-share
info.summary: Automatically shares finished Talk call recordings into the conversation chat
info.description:
When the Talk recording server uploads a call recording, this app shares it into the conversation chat on behalf of the user who started the recording, exactly as if they had clicked "Share" on the notification. Only opted-in conversations are handled.
Optionally it starts recording automatically when a call starts, and it records video calls in grid view (all participants) instead of Talk's speaker view.
Requires Nextcloud 34 (Hub 26 Spring) with Talk 24.
info.author: Pavle Ergović
